long_name: Ethernet PTP time stamp control register (ETH_PTPTSCR)
description: Ethernet PTP time stamp control register specification

bit_fields.name: TSFCU
bit_fields.description: Time stamp fine or coarse update

bit_fields.name: TSSARFE
bit_fields.description: Time stamp snapshot for all received frames enable

bit_fields.name: TSSSR
bit_fields.description: Time stamp subsecond rollover: digital or binary rollover control

bit_fields.name: TSPTPPSV2E
bit_fields.description: Time stamp PTP packet snooping for version2 format enable

bit_fields.name: TSSPTPOEFE
bit_fields.description: Time stamp snapshot for PTP over ethernet frames enable

bit_fields.name: TSSIPV6FE
bit_fields.description: Time stamp snapshot for IPv6 frames enable

bit_fields.name: TSSIPV4FE
bit_fields.description: Time stamp snapshot for IPv4 frames enable

bit_fields.name: TSSEME
bit_fields.description: Time stamp snapshot for event message enable

bit_fields.name: TSSMRME
bit_fields.description: Time stamp snapshot for message relevant to master enable

bit_fields.name: TSPFFMAE
bit_fields.description: Time stamp PTP frame filtering MAC address enable
